parsed.main_gap: Lemma 4 falsely infers that the entire multigraph is acyclic from |E|<|V|.

errors.description: A graph with fewer edges than vertices may still have a cyclic component alongside isolated vertices. Thus the component containing vertex n is not shown to be a tree. The proof is readily repairable by choosing any tree component, whose existence follows by summing edge–vertex counts over components.
errors.quote: Since $|E|<|V|$, the multigraph $G$ contains no cycle and no loop

parsed.notes: Apart from this localized graph-theoretic error, the reduction, lower-bound mechanism, and upper-bound cross-pairing construction are coherent and rigorous.
